annotations.title: Search UK homes with one plain-English query

description: Search live OpenMoov homes for sale or to rent with one plain-English query, e.g. "3 bed house in Folkestone under £350k with a garden" or "flats to rent CT20". Name a town or UK postcode. Understands sale/rent, bedrooms, price limits, property type (flat, house, detached, semi-detached, terraced, bungalow) and garden, parking, garage, new build, chain free and pet friendly. Returns up to 12 results, each with an id to pass to fetch, a one-line title and its openmoov.co.uk url. Made for clients that use the standard search and fetch tools (ChatGPT deep research); search_properties takes the same filters as separate arguments.
